text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон finishes the Satsuki Sho
with a
magnificent victory, securing the
center spot in
the winning concert.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Faced with a packed venue of cheering
fans, she
sees the world through the
eyes of a top Umadol
for the first time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She wants to see the same sight after a
dirt race
next. With her objective clearly
decided...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон decides to advance on to
one of the
few classic G1 dirt races—the
Japan Dirt Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
